# Input OTP

> One-time-code field with grouped, focus-aware slots.

This file matches the installed `input-otp` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/input-otp.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/input-otp.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/field-knobs`: `fieldKnobs`, types `FieldKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/input-otp`: `InputOTPSlot`, `InputOTPSeparator`, `InputOTP`, types `InputOTPProps`, `InputOTPSlotLabel`, `InputOTPSlotProps`, `InputOTPSeparatorProps`

## Composition

### Custom digit groups

Pass length and separator to generate the slots automatically, or compose indexed slots as children.

```tsx
<InputOTP>
  first digit group
    <InputOTPSlot />
  <InputOTPSeparator />
  remaining digits
    <InputOTPSlot />
</InputOTP>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { InputOTP } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/input-otp";
import { Label } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/label";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

export function PrimitiveInputOtpExample() {
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [pin, setPin] = useState("");
  const [submittedCode, setSubmittedCode] = useState<string | null>(null);

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <Label htmlFor="otp-verify">Verification code</Label>
        <InputOTP
          id="otp-verify"
          length={6}
          value={code}
          onValueChange={(nextCode) => {
            setCode(nextCode);
            setSubmittedCode(null);
          }}
          onValueComplete={setSubmittedCode}
          aria-label="Verification code"
        />
        <Text size="caption" tone="muted" role="status">
          {submittedCode ? `Verifying ${submittedCode}…` : `Enter the 6-digit code (${code.length}/6)`}
        </Text>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <Label htmlFor="otp-pin">PIN with separator</Label>
        <InputOTP id="otp-pin" length={6} separator value={pin} onValueChange={setPin} aria-label="PIN" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
